_what_this_is: The register of every tracked Markdown document and its class, which decides what tests/test_documentation_process.py checks for it. Classes: generated (a script writes it; must name the script and, once regenerated after 2026-10-16, carry the provenance stamp), living (hand-written, kept current by overwriting; reviewed and as_of_commit say when it was last read against the repository), record (dated, corrected by a dated addition; append_only means the committed text must be a prefix of the working tree), frozen (sha256 pinned), draft (no claim about the current state). family groups the versions one script wrote for different runs, and current: true on one of them names the current version, which is the one generated on the tables the registered model reads, v5 (the owner, 20 November 2026). docs/documentation_process.md states the rules; experiments/register_documents.py adds and prunes entries.
_how_it_is_enforced: tests/test_documentation_process.py fails for a tracked document that is not registered, an entry whose file is not tracked, an entry with confirmed: false, a frozen document whose sha256 moved, a generated document regenerated after the policy date without a stamp, a living document that describes a container or a session, an append-only record whose committed text was edited, and a decision id that was dropped or renumbered.
